terra.problem: The text gives no street. It also does not say the same-day instruction was meant to keep the offering from sitting on a shelf.
The passage tells Zechariah to go to Josiah’s house; it does not say that he went.
“Grab the wrong one” uses “wrong” about the baker’s answer.
“Just to be sure” assigns a reason for the repetition that the text does not give.
The passage does not mention an altar or say that an altar is part of the temple the Branch will build.
The claim that the Bible uses a shepherd as a picture of a ruler elsewhere needs a reference.
“The ruler and the priest are on one throne” suggests two people on the throne. The passage says the Branch rules and is a priest on His throne, while leaving “the two” unexplained.
The joke compares peaceful counsel to people fighting, so the comparison does not match the action in the passage.
The passage does not say that people standing nearby are building the temple.
The explanation attributes “listening and doing” to the word “diligently.” That explains obedience rather than diligence.
